initial.lightMaterialIdentification: Exact runtime MeshBasicMaterial colors matched to existing factories; no new material factory/cache calls. Missing or occluded ROI is recorded, not treated as a style pass.

cityStats.ownership: Own emitted geometry, far instances and material clones; borrow all station atlases, far facade textures and gradient maps. Dispose before station.
cityStats.limitation: Background only: no new physics or navigable interiors. Foundations and stairs are CPU checked; camera composition and visible CDLOD contacts need GPU acceptance.

initial.method: Sampler-only scope: actual C10 scene/nine assets; shop-interior only, time14/AO.55, one warmup plus two captures, followed by six centers x16 exact GPU AO taps. Other inherited view definitions are not captured. No performance or source change.

exitScope: Derived from driver/report ok; not a persisted OS process exit observation.

samplingEvidence.method: Exact wbDepth/wbPos/wbNormal/wbAO extracted from actual finalMat; same live depth texture/uniform values; RGBA32F GPU output read as Float32Array. CPU only serializes fields and cross-checks their sum, not a depth/AO substitute.
samplingEvidence.rayLimit: Geometry intersections only; ignore alpha/clipping/depthWrite. GPU sampled depth is authoritative. Rays use actual nearest depth texel centers, but alpha/clipping/depthWrite may still differ; compare GPU linearDepth with ray view depth before object attribution.
